record.question: Which one of the following statement is correct with reference to mineral stability?
options: A stable mineral association is that which has the highest free energy possible under a particular circumstance.
A mineral association is unstable when it is not the association with the highest free energy under specific conditions.
A metastable association is one with more than the minimum free energy for the system but in which the rate of change to an association with lower free energy is so slow as to be undetectable.
